title: Seismic hazard around the 2010 Canterbury earthquake epicentre
credit: Global Seismic Hazard Assessment Program, United States Geological Survey; public-domain federal government map.
altText: Seismic hazard map of the central South Island around the epicentre of the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake.
caption: USGS/GSHAP hazard map showing estimated peak ground acceleration with a ten per cent probability of exceedance over fifty years, for the region around the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake. This is a hazard forecast, not a measured shaking map or the emergency response Common Operating Picture.
context: Original USGS hazard map associated with the 2010 Darfield earthquake. It illustrates background seismic risk geography rather than observed ground shaking or Jithen Singh's earthquake response GIS.
